aboutGame.title: What is Do Disciplinary Committee Members Dream of Succubi?
paragraphs: Do Disciplinary Committee Members Dream of Succubi is Milky Way's adults-only RPG, localised in English by Kagura Games. Iroha Himeno is a straight-laced disciplinary committee member who meets the succubus Lily on patrol and accepts a Pact that makes her part succubus.

By day, Iroha patrols the city, attends seminars, works jobs and solves puzzles to build skills, money and Charm. By night, she visits the succubus town of Ligo and trains in the Dream Corridor before facing the Chosen in a demonic proxy war. Our wiki maps the loop, cast, combat and endings.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers about Do Disciplinary Committee Members Dream of Succubi, its cast, day/night loop, combat and endings.

items.question: What is Do Disciplinary Committee Members Dream of Succubi?
items.answer: It is Milky Way's adults-only RPG, localised by Kagura Games. Iroha Himeno accepts a Pact from the succubus Lily, becomes part succubus, and must fight the Chosen in a demonic proxy war.

items.question: Who are the main characters in Do Disciplinary Committee Members Dream of Succubi?
items.answer: Iroha Himeno is the protagonist, Lily is the succubus Pact-maker, Yuno Aiba is Iroha's best friend, Nashi Okane is a bullied student, and the Chosen are humans who made pacts with demons.

items.question: How does the day/night loop work in Do Disciplinary Committee Members Dream of Succubi?
items.answer: Daytime is for patrols, seminars, jobs, puzzles and city exploration, which build skills, money and Charm. At night, Iroha travels to Ligo and trains in the Dream Corridor.

items.question: Can you lose a fight in Do Disciplinary Committee Members Dream of Succubi?
items.answer: Yes. Losing to a Chosen opens a defeat route instead of a standard game over. At the final battle, losing leads to ED03, so keep a save before the fight.

items.question: Where can you play Do Disciplinary Committee Members Dream of Succubi?
items.answer: The English release is Steam app 4233960 for Windows. The Japanese PC original is DLsite RJ01241743, and a separate Japanese iOS/Android edition is RJ01398608. There is no official English APK or free full download.

items.question: How long is Do Disciplinary Committee Members Dream of Succubi?
items.answer: DLsite lists roughly 25 hours of play, with the total varying according to how many optional scenes and recollection-room entries you collect.
